headline: Council approved indoor entertainment licenses for Brickyard Hollow Brewing and Good Theater, sidewalk easements, a police donation, and an electrical code amendment.
summary: The City Council passed consent items granting entertainment license approvals to Brickyard Hollow Brewing Co. and Good Theater Inc, and approved sidewalk easements from the Portland Housing Development Corporation. The Council also accepted a $4,028 donation for the Portland Police Department and passed an amendment to the City Code on the National Electric Code. Two informational communications on social housing and the Before & After the Bell Program required no action.
decisions: Approved Order 17-26/27 granting municipal officers' approval of Brickyard Hollow Brewing Co. Inc's application for indoor entertainment at 5 Commercial Street, 7-0.
Approved Order 18-26/27 granting municipal officers' approval of Good Theater Inc's application for auditorium with indoor entertainment at 631 Stevens Avenue, 7-0.
Approved Order 33-26/27 approving sidewalk easements from the Portland Housing Development Corporation to the City of Portland, 7-0.
Approved Order 14-26/27 accepting and appropriating a $4,028 donation from Diane Ricciotti for the Portland Police Department, 8-0.
Approved Order 16-26/27 amendment to Portland City Code Chapter 6 regarding the National Electric Code, 8-0.
